prior_failed_gpu_attempts.cause: System Python lacked development headers required by Triton.
Conda C++ runtime could not load a FlashInfer extension compiled with the newer system compiler.

resolution: Complete Python 3.13 environment with headers, system C++ runtime preload, Triton prefill, and PyTorch sampling backend.
note: Historical completion snapshot verified against Slurm accounting. Both runs contain all 530 predictions and were evaluated without label-repair retries. Scores are reference agreement, not independently adjudicated medical truth.
